_doc: The Empty's frame (scripts/match/empty_frame.gd, docs/CHARACTER_CREATOR.md): each body slider 0..1 maps onto [lo, hi] for the body's sex (f / m), a factor on the shape (the five added on 11-27 are 1.0 at neutral, so an older body keeps its shape): waist x the torso's width at the waist, chest x the bust (hers) or chest (his) fullness, arms x the arms' thickness, legs x the legs' length, tone x the upper arms' and thighs' thickness over the rest of the limb. Shoulder and hip ranges do not overlap between the sexes, so a woman always reads narrower on top and wider below than any man, and no slider leaves the range the outfits are built for (the clothes are the body's own parts, so they follow every slider; the cloaks are cut to the frame).
